pr_title: KEP-5589: Drop temporary build-tagged ProtoMessage methods

primary_change.symbol: ProtoMessage marker stubs across all staging/src/k8s.io/api/* and related packages

blast_radius_shape.reasoning: All 76+ generated.protomessage.pb.go files across staging packages are guarded by the build tag 'kubernetes_protomessage_one_more_release'. This tag is NOT a default build tag; it must be explicitly set at build time. A search of the kubernetes/kubernetes source code (excluding CHANGELOGs and vendor/) finds zero files that use this build tag in hand-written code. The ProtoMessage() stubs were introduced in v1.35 as an escape hatch exclusively for external downstream consumers who relied on k8s API types implementing proto.Message. No internal kubernetes code path depends on these stubs. Deleting all 76+ files has ZERO compile-time or runtime impact on any standard or test build of the repository.
